svg.title: From a terminal diff to the changed Markdown passage
svg.desc: PTY output is interpreted by xterm, then AgentTerm reads the terminal buffer for diff context. In the first screenshot, the header names notes.md and two added display rows belong to source line 5. Clicking any added or deleted diff row opens the Markdown document at Before publishing. Added rows highlight green; deleted rows land on the next surviving line and highlight blue. The second screenshot shows an added-row landing. These are screenshots of a temporary example in AgentTerm.
svg.text: Click any diff row → highlight the changed passage
